meditation.es:
En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.

Santa María Goretti, que, fortalecida por la gracia de Dios, no dudaste, aun siendo tan joven,
 en derramar tu sangre y sacrificar la vida misma para defender tu pureza virginal, mira con bondad al desdichado género humano, que se ha alejado tanto del camino de la salvación eterna.

Enséñanos a todos, y especialmente a los jóvenes, con qué valentía y prontitud debemos huir, por amor a Jesús, de todo lo que pueda ofenderlo o manchar nuestras almas con el pecado.

Obtennos de nuestro Señor la victoria en la tentación, el consuelo en las penas de la vida y la gracia que te pedimos encarecidamente,

(menciona tu petición aquí…)

y que un día gocemos contigo de la gloria imperecedera del cielo.

Amén.

Amabilísima pequeña Santa, que valoraste tu pureza por encima de cualquier ganancia terrena y sellaste esta elección con una muerte de mártir, obtenme también a mí un amor fuerte a esta virtud, tan consoladora para el Sagrado Corazón de Jesús y el Inmaculado Corazón de María. Los placeres del mundo me crean muchas tentaciones. Acudo a tu poderosa intercesión en el Cielo, para que con esta ayuda permanezca siempre fiel a Dios, cueste lo que cueste. En el peligro, inspírame a repetir contigo: ¡No, es pecado!

meditation.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Saint Maria Goretti who, strengthened by God’s grace, did not hesitate, even at a young age,
 to shed your blood and sacrifice life itself to defend your virginal purity, look graciously on the unhappy human race, which has strayed far from the path of eternal salvation.

Teach us all, and especially youth, with what courage and promptitude we should flee for the love of Jesus, anything that could offend Him or stain our souls with sin.

Obtain for us from our Lord victory in temptation, comfort in the sorrows of life, and the grace which we earnestly beg of Thee,

(mention request here…)

and may we one day enjoy with Thee the imperishable glory of heaven.

Most lovable little Saint, who valued your purity above any earthly gain, and who sealed this choice with a martyr’s death, obtain for me also a strong love of this virtue, so consoling to the Sacred Heart of Jesus and the Immaculate Heart of Mary. The pleasures of the world create many temptations for me. I turn to your powerful intercession in Heaven, so that with this help I may remain ever loyal to God, no matter what the price. In danger inspire me to repeat with you, No, it is a sin!

Teach us all, and especially youth, with what courage and promptitude we should flee for the love of Jesus, anything that could offend Him or stain our souls with sin.

Obtain for us from our Lord victory in temptation, comfort in the sorrows of life, and the grace which we earnestly beg of Thee,

(mention request here…)

and may we one day enjoy with Thee the imperishable glory of heaven.

Dear Little Saint Mary! You were ready for the moment of martyrdom because your short life was given over to daily and heroic self-denial. Your great love of the Sacred Hearts made all this possible. This keeps me from being a true follower of Christ. Help me, lovable Little Martyr, to a sincere practice of self-denial, so that I may be your worthy follower and thus gain Heaven for all Eternity.

Enséñanos a todos, y especialmente a los jóvenes, con qué valentía y prontitud debemos huir, por amor a Jesús, de todo lo que pueda ofenderlo o manchar nuestras almas con el pecado.

(menciona tu petición aquí…)

y que un día gocemos contigo de la gloria imperecedera del cielo.

Enséñame con tu heroico ejemplo a contentarme con lo que tengo, a estar agradecido por las bendiciones que Dios ya ha derramado sobre mí.

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Saint Maria Goretti who, strengthened by God’s grace, did not hesitate, even at a young age,
 to shed your blood and sacrifice life itself to defend your virginal purity, look graciously on the unhappy human race, which has strayed far from the path of eternal salvation.

Teach us all, and especially youth, with what courage and promptitude we should flee for the love of Jesus, anything that could offend Him or stain our souls with sin.

Obtain for us from our Lord victory in temptation, comfort in the sorrows of life, and the grace which we earnestly beg of Thee,

(mention request here…)

and may we one day enjoy with Thee the imperishable glory of heaven.

Dear Little Saint! Your days were spent in the filth of the marshes, willingly helping your desperately poor parents and family. Obtain for me the grace to accept my present circumstances in life, no matter how difficult or humiliating they may be. Just one little drop of water, was the only request that fell from your parched lips during those last horrible hours of life. How much I demand, how unhappy I am when I cannot have my share of the world’s conveniences and gaudy attractions! Teach me by your heroic example to be content with what I have, to be grateful for the blessings God has already showered upon me.

Saint Maria Goretti who, strengthened by God’s grace, did not hesitate, even at a young age,
 to shed your blood and sacrifice life itself to defend your virginal purity, look graciously on the unhappy human race, which has strayed far from the path of eternal salvation.

Teach us all, and especially youth, with what courage and promptitude we should flee for the love of Jesus, anything that could offend Him or stain our souls with sin.

Obtain for us from our Lord victory in temptation, comfort in the sorrows of life, and the grace which we earnestly beg of Thee,

(mention request here…)

and may we one day enjoy with Thee the imperishable glory of heaven.

Dear Little Saint, I depend a great deal upon the help of my friends in time of trouble or sorrow. I look for their approval in many things I do. I am disconsolate and lonely when they desert me. Through your powerful intercession in Heaven, obtain for me the grace to place all my confidence in God. Only by walking constantly in His presence and depending upon His help, will I have the courage to stand up for His laws, even though it may mean loss of friends, criticism and complete removal of worldly comfort. Help me to look for all of my strength in Him.

meditation.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Saint Maria Goretti who, strengthened by God’s grace, did not hesitate, even at a young age,
 to shed your blood and sacrifice life itself to defend your virginal purity, look graciously on the unhappy human race, which has strayed far from the path of eternal salvation.

Teach us all, and especially youth, with what courage and promptitude we should flee for the love of Jesus, anything that could offend Him or stain our souls with sin.

Obtain for us from our Lord victory in temptation, comfort in the sorrows of life, and the grace which we earnestly beg of Thee,

(mention request here…)

and may we one day enjoy with Thee the imperishable glory of heaven.

Amen.

Dear Little Martyr! To the last you followed your beloved Jesus. He, while hanging upon His Cross of Suffering, uttered through parched lips, Father, forgive them for they know not what they do. And you upon your bed of pain, burning with fever, forgave your murderer with the words, I too, pardon him… I too, wish him to join me in Paradise. Grant me the grace, O Heroic Saint, to be charitable to others. Much of my time is spent on vengeful thoughts, seeking how I may pay back to others the harm they have done to me. Teach me to forgive, so that I may not only gain Heaven, but also lead others there who might otherwise be doomed to Hell. If I am to follow Christ, help me to imitate His Charity, even as you have done.

Em nome do Pai, do Filho e do Espírito Santo.

Amém.

Santa Maria Goretti, que, fortalecida pela graça de Deus, não hesitastes, ainda tão jovem,
 em derramar o vosso sangue e sacrificar a própria vida para defender a vossa pureza virginal, olhai com bondade para o infeliz gênero humano, que se afastou tanto do caminho da salvação eterna.

Ensinai a todos nós, e especialmente aos jovens, com que coragem e prontidão devemos fugir, por amor de Jesus, de tudo o que possa ofendê-Lo ou manchar as nossas almas com o pecado.

Alcançai-nos de nosso Senhor a vitória na tentação, o consolo nas dores da vida e a graça que vos pedimos ardentemente,

(mencione o pedido aqui…)

e que um dia gozemos convosco a glória imperecível do céu.

Querida pequena mártir! Até o fim seguistes o vosso amado Jesus. Ele, pendurado na Sua Cruz de sofrimento, disse com lábios ressequidos: Pai, perdoa-lhes, porque não sabem o que fazem. E vós, no vosso leito de dor, ardendo em febre, perdoastes o vosso assassino com as palavras: Eu também o perdoo… eu também quero que ele esteja comigo no Paraíso. Concedei-me a graça, ó heroica santa, de ser caridoso com os outros. Passo muito tempo em pensamentos de vingança, procurando como pagar aos outros o mal que me fizeram. Ensinai-me a perdoar, para que eu não só ganhe o Céu, mas também leve para lá outros que de outro modo poderiam estar condenados ao Inferno. Se devo seguir Cristo, ajudai-me a imitar a Sua caridade, como vós fizestes.

 en derramar tu sangre y sacrificar la vida misma para defender tu pureza virginal, mira con bondad al desdichado género humano, que se ha alejado tanto del camino de la salvación eterna.

Enséñanos a todos, y especialmente a los jóvenes, con qué valentía y prontitud debemos huir, por amor a Jesús, de todo lo que pueda ofenderlo o manchar nuestras almas con el pecado.

Obtennos de nuestro Señor la victoria en la tentación, el consuelo en las penas de la vida y la gracia que te pedimos encarecidamente,

(menciona tu petición aquí…)

y que un día gocemos contigo de la gloria imperecedera del cielo.

Amén.

Querida santa María Goretti, una vez más acudo a ti y te pido, con las palabras de nuestro Santo Padre el papa Pío XII, aquella serenidad de espíritu y aquella alegría profunda que son la herencia de los limpios de corazón. Ayúdame a acudir a Nuestra Señora, confiado en la esperanza de que tomará mi mano como tomó la tuya y me llevará al Paraíso, mi patria celestial, para gozar allí contigo y con Ella de la compañía de Dios Padre, Hijo y Espíritu Santo por toda la Eternidad.

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Saint Maria Goretti who, strengthened by God’s grace, did not hesitate, even at a young age,
 to shed your blood and sacrifice life itself to defend your virginal purity, look graciously on the unhappy human race, which has strayed far from the path of eternal salvation.

Teach us all, and especially youth, with what courage and promptitude we should flee for the love of Jesus, anything that could offend Him or stain our souls with sin.

Obtain for us from our Lord victory in temptation, comfort in the sorrows of life, and the grace which we earnestly beg of Thee,

(mention request here…)

and may we one day enjoy with Thee the imperishable glory of heaven.

Amen.

Dear Saint Maria Goretti, once again I turn to you, and beg of you in the words of Our Holy Father, Pope Pius XII, that serenity of spirit and deep joy which is the heritage of those who are pure of heart. Help me to turn to Our Blessed Lady, confident in the hope that she will take my hand as she did yours, and lead me on to Paradise, my heavenly country, there to enjoy with you and Her, the company of God the Father, Son and Holy Ghost for all Eternity.

Santa Maria Goretti, que, fortalecida pela graça de Deus, não hesitastes, ainda tão jovem,
 em derramar o vosso sangue e sacrificar a própria vida para defender a vossa pureza virginal, olhai com bondade para o infeliz gênero humano, que se afastou tanto do caminho da salvação eterna.

Ensinai a todos nós, e especialmente aos jovens, com que coragem e prontidão devemos fugir, por amor de Jesus, de tudo o que possa ofendê-Lo ou manchar as nossas almas com o pecado.

Alcançai-nos de nosso Senhor a vitória na tentação, o consolo nas dores da vida e a graça que vos pedimos ardentemente,

(mencione o pedido aqui…)

e que um dia gozemos convosco a glória imperecível do céu.

Querida Santa Maria Goretti, mais uma vez recorro a vós e vos peço, com as palavras do nosso Santo Padre o Papa Pio XII, aquela serenidade de espírito e aquela alegria profunda que são a herança dos puros de coração.
